podcast.title: Successor to Among Guard
podcast.body: Among Guard, Rivers Cuomo's early band, changed their name to Zoom before ultimately breaking up in 1990. "Among Guard didn't last very long. They changed their name to Zoom and then broke up in 1990."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
